hooks.command: jq -r '.tool_response.filePath // .tool_input.file_path' | { read -r p; case "$p" in *.gen.cs) ;; *.cs) [ -f "$p" ] && { head -5 "$p" | grep -q "The .NET Foundation licenses this file to you under the MIT license." || printf '{"systemMessage":"Missing MIT license header (IDE0073): %s"}\n' "$p"; };; esac; } 2>/dev/null || true
